# Copilot Instructions — adk-integrator-frontend

Frontend for the ADK (Agent Development Kit) integrator platform.

## Key Rules
- Secrets in `.env` only — never committed
- API keys via environment variables only
- Keep mobile-responsive (Cal accesses from iPhone)
- Follow accessibility best practices (WCAG 2.1 AA)

## Token Budget
See conductor-brain repo (CONTEXT_CONTROL.md) for agent delegation rules.
